circularity.explanation: The authority commits stable_rule_basis_hash but not the final stable rule ref. The stable rule object then contains the authority ref. No rule ref feeds back into authority_content_hash.

required_edges: owner-native model authority -> stable rule object
stable rule object -> every consuming product
walkback/proxy authority -> each consuming product where consumed
query/comparability/producer authority -> consuming product where consumed
graph_shape.note: Current AnalyticalDependencyRegistry does not yet turn determinant_exact_refs into dependency edges; HQ230 correctly identifies later implementation wiring as required.

omitted_stable_invariants.adopted_basis: Z08 two-lane law; exact SUPPORTED returns immediately, VALID_EMPTY/NONCOMPARABLE are terminal, Lane P may run only when Lane E is unresolved.
omitted_stable_invariants.current_implementation_witness: evaluate_positioned_subject_possibility returns immediately for SUPPORTED/VALID_EMPTY/NONCOMPARABLE before iterating walkback_steps.
omitted_stable_invariants.why_identity_bearing: Allowing walkback after an exact terminal result changes model behavior without changing HQ230 basis.

omitted_stable_invariants.adopted_basis: Z08 requires each step's exact proxy authority ref also appear in positive_proxy_authority_refs; arbitrary AuthorityRef is insufficient.
omitted_stable_invariants.current_implementation_witness: PositionedSubjectPossibilityModelRule.__post_init__ rejects any walkback step proxy_authority_ref absent from positive_proxy_authority_refs.
omitted_stable_invariants.why_identity_bearing: Removing the membership check would broaden authorized proxy behavior while HQ230 stable basis remains unchanged.

omitted_stable_invariants.adopted_basis: Z08 consumes typed upstream states; unsupported proxy evidence is recorded but cannot satisfy proxy support.
omitted_stable_invariants.current_implementation_witness: candidate.evidence_state != 'SUPPORTED' records PROXY_EVIDENCE_<state> and continues rather than selecting proxy.
omitted_stable_invariants.why_identity_bearing: Permitting UNDERPOWERED/UNRESOLVED/VALID_EMPTY/NONCOMPARABLE/UNAVAILABLE proxy evidence to satisfy a proxy would change the model law without changing HQ230 basis.

omitted_stable_invariants.adopted_basis: Each retained conditioner set is a strict subset of both the original requested set and the immediately preceding retained set; sibling surrogate/re-widening is forbidden.
omitted_stable_invariants.current_implementation_witness: evaluation checks retained < requested and retained < previous; SpecificityLoss.build also requires retained < requested.
omitted_stable_invariants.why_identity_bearing: The generic phrase walkback_steps_strictly_decrease_specificity does not freeze the exact set-theoretic relation and can admit a different notion of specificity.

stable_rule_basis_attack.consequence: The proposed owner rule can remain at the same de15... / 59e... identity across behaviorally material drift. This is exactly the lifecycle failure Option B was intended to prevent.
stable_rule_basis_attack.required_correction: Re-freeze a complete stable semantic basis including the omitted invariants; then transitively recompute interpretation, authority, rule, crosswalk, evidence and candidate identities.
